$$

\boxed{144} \text{ cubic meters}

$$
(n - 1)!

$$
5! \times 3! = 120 \times 6 = 720
$$

\boxed{720}

$$

$$

$$
Ax^2 + Bxy + Cy^2 + Dx + Ey + F = 0.
$$
In our case:

$$

This implies that the function must be the **zero function**, i.e., $ f(x) = 0 $ for all $ x \in \mathbb{R} $.

$$
